assets.name: gear-purple
assets.method: violet score max(0, B-max(R,G)) -> soft alpha ramp -> 8-connected component filtering -> enclosed-hole fill
assets.notes: Gear centre hole intentionally transparent (hole policy 'none'; the purple body has no other enclosed holes), so the button face shows through as designed.

assets.name: home-crown-large
assets.method: warm-hue gated saturation score 255*(max-min)/max (kept only where R>=G>=B) -> soft alpha ramp -> 8-connected component filtering -> enclosed-hole fill
assets.notes: Panel text (top-score label / value) excluded - only the gold crown glyph is kept. All enclosed interior holes (the central vertical shine and the smaller highlights) are filled OPAQUE with the source RGB; the gold body contains no transparent speckling. Readiness: assembly-only, NOT standalone-ready. The lower edge is occluded in the flattened render by the score panel and its daisy/leaf trim, so that edge is irregular. Play it over the score panel (or any cover) so the bottom trim hides the edge; on a bare background the 'kept' lower edge is visible. A flat cut was tried and rejected: it truncated the crown mid-body at source y=670 and read clearly worse.

assets.name: hud-crown-best
assets.method: warm-hue gated saturation score 255*(max-min)/max (kept only where R>=G>=B) -> soft alpha ramp -> 8-connected component filtering -> enclosed-hole fill
assets.notes: Row plate / label text excluded. All enclosed interior highlights are filled opaque from the source RGB.

assets.name: hud-trophy-score
assets.method: warm-hue gated saturation score 255*(max-min)/max (kept only where R>=G>=B) -> soft alpha ramp -> 8-connected component filtering -> enclosed-hole fill
assets.notes: Row plate / numeral text excluded. Hole policy: the two genuine handle openings stay transparent (they show the plate's shadowed tan); the cup-body shine and every pale-gold interior region are filled opaque from the source RGB.

assets.name: logo-voxalblast
assets.role: Home title lockup: wordmark + leaf/daisy decoration (subtitle excluded)
assets.method: warm/green chroma score max(R-B, G-max(R,B)) -> soft alpha ramp (antialiased silhouette) -> 8-connected component filtering -> enclosed-hole fill
assets.notes: Subtitle band (CJK tagline, top row measured at source y=420) deliberately excluded. Three exclusion rects remove non-logo background that overlaps the window corners: tree foliage top-left, a branch top-right, and a tan scene object bottom-left; see 'exclude_rects_in_source'. Near-white daisy petals rely on their warm shading plus enclosed-interior fill; the outermost petal tips that sit against the blue sky may be a little soft.

assets.name: nav-crown-small
assets.method: warm-hue gated saturation score 255*(max-min)/max (kept only where R>=G>=B) -> soft alpha ramp -> 8-connected component filtering -> enclosed-hole fill
assets.notes: Cut from the cream button face; button border/plate intentionally not included. All enclosed interior highlights are filled opaque from the source RGB - the crown must have no transparent speckling inside the gold.

assets.name: play-triangle
assets.method: per-row background-difference score (max channel delta to that row's edge colour) -> soft alpha ramp -> 8-connected component filtering
assets.notes: Lowest-contrast cut in the set: glyph sits on the gold pill, so the mask is a per-row background-difference rather than a colour class. Enclosed regions are filled opaque from the source RGB, so the solid gold triangle carries no transparent pinholes.

assets.name: plus-gold
assets.method: warm-hue gated saturation score 255*(max-min)/max (kept only where R>=G>=B) -> soft alpha ramp -> 8-connected component filtering -> enclosed-hole fill
assets.notes: Cut from the cream button face.

assets.name: settings-book
assets.role: Settings row glyph: how to play / open book
assets.method: warm-hue gated saturation score 255*(max-min)/max (kept only where R>=G>=B) -> soft alpha ramp -> 8-connected component filtering -> enclosed-hole fill
assets.notes: Page gutter of the book is kept opaque (enclosed interior fill).

assets.name: settings-close-x
assets.role: Settings close X glyph (optional static glyph)
assets.method: darkness score 255-max for warm pixels (R>=B) -> soft alpha ramp -> 8-connected component filtering -> enclosed-hole fill
assets.notes: Cut from the gold disc only; the cream ring and the leaf trim behind the disc are excluded.

assets.name: settings-home
assets.role: Settings row glyph: back to home
assets.method: warm-hue gated saturation score 255*(max-min)/max (kept only where R>=G>=B) -> soft alpha ramp -> 8-connected component filtering -> enclosed-hole fill
assets.notes: House glyph; recessed areas follow the source shading (one enclosed hole kept transparent). No row plate or label text.

assets.name: settings-restart
assets.role: Settings row glyph: restart (white on red plate)
assets.method: whiteness score 255-(max-min) -> soft alpha ramp -> 8-connected component filtering -> enclosed-hole fill
assets.notes: White glyph on the saturated red plate; plate is not included.

assets.name: settings-speaker
assets.method: warm-hue gated saturation score 255*(max-min)/max (kept only where R>=G>=B) -> soft alpha ramp -> 8-connected component filtering -> enclosed-hole fill
assets.notes: Speaker body plus two sound-wave arcs are separate components; all are kept (min_area 40). No row plate or label text included.

assets.name: settings-turn
assets.role: Settings row glyph: block turn / flip
assets.method: warm-hue gated saturation score 255*(max-min)/max (kept only where R>=G>=B) -> soft alpha ramp -> 8-connected component filtering -> enclosed-hole fill
assets.notes: Curved block-turn arrow cut from the flat cream row; no row plate or label text.

assets.name: settings-vibration
assets.role: Settings row glyph: haptics / vibrating phone
assets.method: warm-hue gated saturation score 255*(max-min)/max (kept only where R>=G>=B) -> soft alpha ramp -> 8-connected component filtering -> enclosed-hole fill
assets.notes: Side motion arcs are separate small components and are kept (low min_area).

assets.name: close-button.png
assets.method: source crop + antialiased silhouette
assets.notes: Includes fixed X glyph. Button needs localized aria-label. Do not overlay a second X.

assets.name: home-nav.png
assets.method: source crop + clean vertical band + antialiased silhouette
assets.notes: Unlettered navigation shell; crown/gear and localized label are separate elements.

assets.name: home-primary.png
assets.method: source gold-face crop + clean band + matching endcaps
assets.notes: Continue background. No arrow or text. Endcaps are reconstructed; not pixel-identical to flower-covered concept. Endcaps/frame are resampled from the clean home-nav source (home bbox 435,1578,793,1734), not recovered hidden pixels.

assets.name: home-record.png
assets.method: source body crop + label/number removal with clean band
assets.notes: Body-only high-score panel. Render large crown separately; use fixed aspect ratio, not nine-slice (internal number recess).

assets.name: home-secondary.png
assets.method: source crop + clean band + matching clean endcap reconstruction
assets.notes: New Game background; no plus/label; floral trim omitted from stretchable base. Endcaps/frame are resampled from the clean home-nav source (home bbox 435,1578,793,1734), not recovered hidden pixels.

assets.name: keyboard-hint.png
assets.method: source capsule + glyph removal
assets.notes: No WASDQE letters baked in; use real DOM kbd/text.

assets.name: score-panel.png
assets.method: source plaque + two clean-band restorations + pale-blue chroma matte
assets.notes: Fixed-aspect decorated plaque, NOT nine-slice. Both icons/labels/numbers are removed. BEST=crown, SCORE=trophy via separate DOM layers.

assets.name: settings-danger.png
assets.method: source coral action crop + clean-band restoration
assets.notes: Restart background; render restart glyph and localized label separately.

assets.name: settings-modal.png
assets.method: source frame + clean interior-band reconstruction + undecorated corner restoration
assets.notes: Empty scalable modal shell. Header, close, six/seven rows and corner ornaments are separate; never display this as a whole settings screenshot.

assets.name: settings-row.png
assets.method: source row crop + clean-band restoration
assets.notes: Reusable empty row for sound/haptics/drag-turn/help/home and any existing language row.

assets.name: toggle-off.png
assets.method: derived OFF: desaturated source track + same unmirrored thumb moved left
assets.notes: OFF is reconstructed, not present in approved all-ON concept. Use muted track + left thumb so state is not encoded only by color.

assets.name: toggle-on.png
assets.method: source crop + antialiased rounded silhouette
assets.notes: Entire ON toggle; scale uniformly, do not nine-slice. State remains controlled by real DOM button.

assets.name: toggle-thumb.png
assets.method: source thumb crop + elliptical alpha
assets.notes: Optional separate thumb; do not mirror it, preserve light direction.

sourceCoordinateConvention: Pillow (left, top, right, bottom), right/bottom exclusive; nineSliceTRBL in source pixels.
readiness: Offline sliced-art handoff reviewed on checkerboards; requires in-game layout/i18n/interaction acceptance. Flattened-source restoration is not original layered art.
